independence_declaration.statement: I (qa-verifier) authored no implementation in the reviewed DG0 scope. The analysis, register and acceptance map are by transformation-analyst. The agent definitions, runner, guard, sandbox-run, prefreeze, gate tooling, CI and delivery records are by delivery-orchestrator. My only writes are test evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/ and this record and its sidecars. I opened no other round-14 review record or findings file. Disclosure: the `validate.mjs --reconcile` output at HEAD 8c5a694, which I ran for check QA14-C06b, prints one status line per existing round-14 record. So I saw the other reviewers' verdict words, but no content, findings or reasoning. By then my own checks and finding F-DG0-235 were already complete, and that line did not change my verdict.

Every required command passes: extraction, 50/50 gate tests, 22/22 runner and guard tests, register DG0, pipeline, reconcile, candidate a25db736, and prefreeze 10/10 in a fresh clone. My independent round-14 suite passes 18/18 on the candidate, and 9 of its cases fail on the round-13 commit. The live guard blocks protected writes. Register integrity and agent-load evidence pass. My findings F-DG0-231, F-DG0-233 and F-DG0-234 are CLOSED_VERIFIED. The new finding F-DG0-235 (Low, not mandatory, acceptable as an observation) is that acceptance-map.md does not list the new REQ-DLV-042 under A18, A23 or A24. My feasibility script exits 1 on that drift. QA14-C15's criterion is still met, because every scenario is assigned and testable.
